items.title: Trump threatens EU with tariff probe over Google, tech fines
items.description: US President Donald Trump has said he will initiate a tariff investigation against the EU in response to fines against US tech companies. He cited the latest case that Google lost on Thursday, as well as others.

items.title: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies
items.description: The US president says fines against Google, as well as Apple, Meta and Amazon, should be "entirely reversed."

items.title: World chess chief faces endgame after EU announces Russia war sanctions
items.description: Arkady Dvorkovich, a former Russian deputy prime minister, now faces an EU travel ban and asset freeze.

items.title: Europe wildfires rage on, forcing 200,000 from homes
items.description: Hot, arid weather and strong winds have continued to fuel wildfires in France, Spain and Italy, devastating huge swaths of land and forcing mass evacuations. As national emergencies are declared, the danger remains.

items.title: Europe wildfires: Thousands flee by boat as fires spread, merge
items.description: Tens of thousands of people used cars and boats to escape wildfires raging in southwestern France. In Spain's Madrid region, authorities declared a national emergency after at least two fires merged.
